details: For every nonempty finite binary class, $|\mathcal H|\geq\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{min}}(\mathcal H)+1$.
proof: Every d-star in the definition uses d+1 distinct hypotheses $h_0,\ldots,h_d$. Thus $d\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ for every centre labeling, and in particular $\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{min}}(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$.
name: Size / Minimum Star Number (affine)
